dataset.title: ESA WorldCereal · Mauritius / Réunion · DE Africa archive
dataset.description: Seven model-derived annual/seasonal crop themes from ESA WorldCereal, accessed through Digital Earth Africa's public regional copy. This reviewed release supports the actual standalone publisher items for Mauritius/Réunion (AEZ 9026), reference year 2021; it is not a global scene search or a guarantee of agricultural accuracy.
dataset.version: WorldCereal v1.0.0 · DE Africa AEZ 9026 / 2021 reviewed item index
dataset.attribution: ESA WorldCereal consortium / VITO; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2020–2021). Regional distribution: Digital Earth Africa, public deafrica-input-datasets archive. Cite the original item, AEZ, actual season, product version and access date.
dataset.nominalResolution: 10 m classification (approximately 1/12000 degree); confidence assets have independent publisher grids
dataset.valueInterpretation: Original categorical classification samples, not optical reflectance or observed crop yield. Annual temporary crops, crop-type classes, seasonal active cropland and seasonal active irrigation have different meanings. 254 is a valid no-crop category in seasonal products; it must not be treated as NoData. Embedded TIFF masks and each asset's independent grid are retained without reclassification or calibration.

layers.title: Annual temporary crops
layers.valueInterpretation: 0 other land cover/use, 100 temporary crops. This annual crop mask is not a specific crop-type classification.

layers.title: Active cropland · winter-cereals window
layers.valueInterpretation: 0 inactive, 100 active, 254 no crop. Seasonal activity on the temporary-crop mask; this is not a winter-cereals-only crop-type class.

layers.title: Maize crop type · main season
layers.valueInterpretation: Original main-season maize classification, with publisher codes and masks retained. This theme identifies crop type rather than all active cropland.

layers.title: Active cropland · main maize-season window
layers.valueInterpretation: 0 inactive, 100 active, 254 no crop. Activity on temporary cropland in the main maize-season window; not a maize-only classification.

layers.title: Active irrigation · main maize-season window
layers.valueInterpretation: Original active-irrigation classification on temporary cropland during the main maize-season window. It does not identify exclusively irrigated maize or irrigation infrastructure.

layers.title: Winter-cereals crop type
layers.valueInterpretation: Original seasonal winter-cereals classification, distinct from the general active-cropland theme. Preserve the publisher's categorical legend.

layers.title: Active irrigation · winter-cereals window
layers.valueInterpretation: Original active-irrigation classification on temporary cropland during the winter-cereals season window. It does not identify exclusively irrigated winter cereals.

warnings: Availability is limited to the seven reviewed AEZ 9026 / reference-year 2021 publisher items. An omitted region matches the current map area against their actual published bounding boxes; an area outside the reviewed region fails explicitly. No different AEZ, season, year or product is substituted.

Reference year 2021 does not mean a January–December observation interval. For this AEZ the annual period is 2020-11-09 to 2021-11-09, the main maize-season window is 2020-11-11 to 2021-05-08, and the winter-cereals window is 2021-04-03 to 2021-11-09. Seasonal activity and irrigation do not imply a crop-type-only mask.

Publisher STAC items contain original s3 asset URLs. Only the exact reviewed public bucket, regional endpoint and matching item assets receive a native HTTPS transport receipt; the archived item, asset metadata and original s3 href remain unchanged. No AWS account, temporary signature or private bucket is used.

The standalone items have no collection link, so collection metadata is not retrieved. CC BY 4.0 is a separate documented distribution/TIFF declaration, not an invented STAC collection license. Source-metadata completion does not mean that the collection declaration or valid-pixel coverage has been verified.

The complete regional original is downloaded without clipping. Publisher item bbox and original raster bounds can differ slightly (about 0.2 pixel in the annual example); bbox intersection is not exact geometric or valid-crop coverage. Confidence files are independent assets and must retain their own projection/shape/transform rather than inheriting the classification grid.

Classification 254 means no crop in relevant seasonal themes; only the embedded missing-data mask is used by native inspection. A numerical thumbnail is not a scientific accuracy assessment or evidence that any particular pixel contains crops.

The reviewed annual confidence original contains some raw values 101–253 although its TIFF legend describes confidence as 0–100. Original values are preserved without clipping, conversion to a percentage or inferred calibration. Category 254 remains valid no-crop data; 255 is used as NoData only through the original embedded TIFF declaration. Consult the publisher before scientific interpretation of values outside its legend.
limits: Up to 8 reviewed regional items per selection; this release currently contains one AEZ and seven distinct themes, not seven satellite platforms or global coverage.

Each original file remains limited to 512 MiB. Tiled TIFF axes are limited to 131,072 pixels and 8 billion grid pixels; stripped TIFF axes remain limited to 65,536. Native decoding retains 128 MiB chunk, 32 MiB intermediate, 512 MiB preview-budget and 30-second review bounds. Other publisher AEZ files can exceed these limits and are not silently substituted.
